title: Contextual DM thanks

source.title: Show love to kind messages
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

native.messages_text: "{thanks_text}" once for genuine kind feedback after the campaign word. Use acknowledgment_policy; treat complaints as complaints and clarify sarcasm.

use_when: People send the campaign word with genuine kind feedback in ordinary DMs.

exclude_when: Do not choose when a native reaction operation or automatic sentiment classifier is required.
